_note: The tester's lines (af_heart): drives VoiceOver, says what she hears.

lines.t-hello: Hi, I'm the tester. I'll use VoiceOver, the screen reader built into the Mac, and tell you what I hear.
lines.t-open: Here's a quarterly report, in Safari, with VoiceOver on. Under the heading there's a bar chart of sales for July, August and September. I'll read the page one item at a time, from the link at the top.
lines.t-missing: After the sentence under the heading, VoiceOver said q three sales dot S V G, image. That's the file name. It never said what the chart shows.
lines.t-again: The same reading pass, on the fixed page.
lines.t-heard: Now VoiceOver reads the chart: what kind of chart it is, and the sales for each month.
